description: Address review feedback: fix PM2 env_file, add health check to deploy script, fix certbot mode, add git ref param to deploy, restrict SSH CIDR in provisioning script
steps: Remove env_file from ecosystem.config.cjs (not a real PM2 option) and document that deploy.sh is the supported startup method
Add --ssh-cidr option to aws-provision.sh (defaults to auto-detecting caller IP via curl ifconfig.me)
Add optional git ref parameter to deploy.sh (deploy a specific tag/commit instead of always pulling main)
Add health check after pm2 reload in deploy.sh (curl retry loop on localhost:8080/api/health)
Fix certbot mode in ssl-setup.sh to use --webroot -w /var/www/html instead of --nginx (matches nginx config)
acceptance_criteria: aws-provision.sh accepts --ssh-cidr flag or auto-detects caller IP
deploy.sh accepts optional ref argument to deploy a specific commit/tag
deploy.sh includes a health check after PM2 reload
All shell scripts pass bash -n syntax check
verification: Run bash -n on all .sh files in deploy/
findings: All 5 review issues (critical ones) fixed: PM2 env_file removed, SSH CIDR auto-detect added, deploy ref param added, health check added, certbot --webroot mode applied. All .sh files pass bash -n. ecosystem.config.cjs passes node -c. Lower-priority issues (nginx duplication, frontend build env coupling) left as-is per orchestrator guidance.
